summary: Researchers have designed and developed a modular wrist rehabilitation robot that incorporates impedance control and gravity compensation. summary: A study published in Frontiers examines the effectiveness of robot-assisted therapy for improving muscle strength in hemiplegic patients during gait rehabilitation. The findings suggest that robotic therapy may be a valuable addition to traditional rehabilitation methods.

summary: A randomized controlled trial published in Nature investigated the effects of robotic hand-assisted rehabilitation on motor function and daily living activities in patients with acute stroke. title: The role of early intervention with upper limb rehabilitation robots in upper limb functional reconstruction and improving sarcopenia-related indicators in stroke patients - Nature
